description: Search live job openings in Tokyo, Japan, listed on Ranked (ranked.jp). Built for foreign professionals: filter by whether English is enough, whether Japanese is required, visa sponsorship, remote work and minimum annual salary in yen. Results are ordered by Ranked's rank score. Each job carries its Ranked page, where users can view details and continue to apply, and when the posting was last verified live.

company.description: Only jobs at companies whose name contains this text.

english_workable.description: Only jobs where English is enough (no Japanese requirement stated or reviewed).

no_japanese_required.description: Only jobs that explicitly need no Japanese. Stricter than english_workable.

posted_within_days.description: Only jobs first seen within this many days.

query.description: Keywords matched against title, company, summary and tags, e.g. "backend go" or "robotics".

salary_min.description: Minimum annual salary in JPY, e.g. 8000000. Jobs with no stated salary are excluded.

visa_sponsorship.description: Only jobs whose employer sponsors or may sponsor a work visa. Each result's visa.sponsorship says how sure: supported, likely or possible.

name: search_jobs
title: Search Tokyo jobs
